CustomJoint.kinematic_program: source-derived canonical FunctionBased binary sidecars have bounded Metal pose, H, Hdot, H-transpose wrench projection, and Hdot times qdot primitives; the pinned CPU FP64 reference also admits an immutable FunctionBasedJointProgram into analytic Jacobian mass/bias evaluation and state advance
CustomJoint.requirement: Assemble the source skeleton into EngineModel with source frames and inertias, then extend the accelerated articulated solver. Current Metal ABA/operator/MetalWorld paths explicitly reject FunctionBased joints.

UniversalJoint.requirement: Represent a source-faithful coupled two-axis joint in the articulated solver.

fully_locked_zero_default_lowering.condition: All source coordinates are locked and have exactly zero default value, so the source joint transform is its fixed zero-coordinate transform.

source_faithful_requirements: source-frame muscle force and moment-arm scatter
